howTo.title: How to play
howTo.step1: Press Play. You start with 0.1 seconds and can replay the clip as often as you like.
howTo.step2: Type the song title, pick a result from the list, then press Guess.
howTo.branchCorrect: Right: the song opens up with its artist and cover art.
howTo.branchWrong: Wrong or skipped: the clip grows to 0.5s, then 2s, 8s, 15s. Back to step 1.
howTo.step3: After six guesses the answer opens anyway. Play again, or share your result.
howTo.adjustBody: Difficulty runs from Easy to Impossible and changes how well known the songs are. Genre and era filters, clip lengths, volume, and layout all live in the menu.

quick.title: Quick questions
quick.a1: Yes. Play in your browser, with no account and nothing to install.
quick.q2: Can I play more than once a day?
quick.a2: Yes, there is no daily limit. Press New song as often as you like.
quick.q3: Does it work on my phone?
quick.a3: Yes, on phones, tablets and computers. On small screens the game options sit in the menu.

faq.title: Questions about TebakLagu
faq.intro: Everything below comes from how the game actually works and where its limits are.
faq.q1: Why is the first clip only 0.1 seconds?
faq.a1: Because that is the whole challenge. At 0.1 seconds you are not recognising a melody, you are recognising a texture: a drum hit, a synth stab, the first breath of a vocal. Every wrong guess or skip trades difficulty for time, so the game is really about how little you need.
faq.q2: Why is a song I know missing from the catalogue?
faq.a2: The catalogue is curated by hand and still small, so plenty of songs are not in it yet. A song can also be missing because the preview service has no official 30 second preview for it, and this game never hosts audio itself.
faq.q3: I typed the title correctly but it was marked wrong. Why?
faq.a3: Answers are matched loosely: capitals, punctuation and small typos are forgiven, and alternative titles are accepted. What is not forgiven is a different song, so a guess only counts once you pick a title from the suggestion list. If you believe a correct answer was rejected, the title is probably stored under a spelling the catalogue does not know yet.
faq.q4: My streak disappeared when I switched phones. Why?
faq.a4: Statistics live in this browser's local storage, not in an account, because the game has no sign-up. Clearing site data, using private browsing, or opening the game on another device all start from zero.
faq.q5: Do you play the full song?
faq.a5: No. Only the official 30 second preview supplied by the iTunes Search API is played, and nothing is stored on our side. Playing full tracks would need licences this game does not have.
faq.q6: There is no sound on my phone. What is wrong?
faq.a6: Mobile browsers block audio until you interact with the page, so the first tap switches the sound on rather than playing the clip. If it stays silent after that, check the volume slider in the menu and your phone's silent switch.
faq.q7: What do the blocks in the shared result mean?
faq.a7: They are the clue ladder. Each of the five blocks is one clip length, a light block is a step you never needed, a shaded block is a step you used and got wrong, and a full block is the step where you got it. The song title is never included.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.ownerBody: TebakLagu is run by Sharam. Questions about this policy go to the owner through the channel listed wherever you found this game.
privacy.noAccountBody: The game has no sign-up, no login and no profile. We never ask for your name, your email address or your phone number.
privacy.localBody: Your language, theme, layout, filter and volume choices, plus your streak and guess history, are stored in this browser's local storage. That data never leaves your device and we cannot read it. Clearing your site data erases all of it.
privacy.thirdPartyBody: To play a clip, the game asks our own server for a song, and our server asks the iTunes Search API for that song's details and preview. Apple receives the request from our server, which means it sees our server's address rather than yours. Audio is then streamed to you through our server so that no third party receives your address directly.
privacy.noTrackingBody: There is no analytics script, no advertising network and no tracking cookie on this site. If that ever changes, this page changes with it before the change ships.
privacy.childrenBody: Since the game collects nothing, it is safe for any age. It is still a music quiz, and the catalogue is not filtered for language in the lyrics of the previews.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.acceptBody: TebakLagu is offered free of charge by Sharam, with no account and no payment. By playing, you accept the terms on this page.
terms.audioBody: Every clip is an official preview supplied by the iTunes Search API. The recordings belong to their rights holders, not to this game. Nothing is downloaded, cached permanently or re-hosted here, and the game offers no way to save a clip.
terms.catalogueBody: Song titles, artists and cover art are factual metadata used to identify a recording. If you hold rights to a recording and want it removed from the catalogue, contact the owner and it will be taken out.
terms.availabilityBody: The game depends on a third party preview service that can change or stop at any time. It is provided as is, with no promise that it will be reachable, complete or free of mistakes.
terms.fairUseBody: Automated scraping of the catalogue or the audio proxy, and any attempt to use this game as a music download service, is not allowed.
terms.changesBody: These terms can change as the game grows. The date at the top of this page says when they last did.
